acceptance_rule: A clean parity result requires exact independently pinned legacy and source scope manifests, one complete reviewed row-disposition partition, independently replayed field differences, and explicit structural observations. Every accepted field, row, or structural condition must resolve exactly one active closed policy and replay its own authorization digest; global activation, matching failure, or current output may never create authorization.

authorization_layers.authority: independently pinned legacy capture and source-native product scope
runtime field, counterpart, and structural replay
closed reviewed field, row-disposition, or structural policy register
